# Anoop Sinkaran
Blacktown NSW, Australia • 0406 295 160 • ns.anoop@gmail.com • linkedin.com/in/anoop-sinkaran

## Professional Summary
Seasoned Senior Quality Engineer and QA Lead with over 19 years of experience designing, executing, and automating end-to-end testing strategies across enterprise web applications, cloud platforms, and distributed systems. Accomplished in developing automated test frameworks, validating API integration suites, and embedding quality automation into Azure DevOps and GitHub CI/CD pipelines. Proven track record of driving cross-functional alignment, leading defect triage, and delivering robust software quality using Java, C#, Kotlin, Selenium WebDriver, and modern API testing practices within Agile environments.

* **Languages & Technologies:** Java, Python, C#, Kotlin, SQL, UNIX Shell Scripting, .NET, React, JavaScript, TypeScript
